scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@empiric-webhook-inbox/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@empiric-webhook-inbox/api
scripts.check:foundation: npm run build:contracts && tsx --tsconfig tests/tsconfig.json --test tests/foundation.test.ts
scripts.check:mongo: npm run build:contracts && tsx --tsconfig tests/tsconfig.json --test tests/mongo.test.ts
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@empiric-webhook-inbox/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@empiric-webhook-inbox/web
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@empiric-webhook-inbox/api && npm run build --workspace=@empiric-webhook-inbox/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:routing: npm run build:contracts && tsx --tsconfig tests/tsconfig.json --test tests/routing.test.ts
scripts.check:contracts: npm run build:contracts && vitest run tests/unit/contracts.test.ts tests/api/contracts.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:contracts && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:api: npm run build:contracts && vitest run --project api
scripts.local:inbox: npm run build:api && npm run local:inbox --workspace=@empiric-webhook-inbox/api --
